Content: A professional photographer takes `400` photos during a weekend event. After reviewing the images, she determines that `15%` of the photos are of high enough quality to be included in a promotional portfolio.
What is the total number of photos from the event that will be included in the portfolio?
A high school has a total of `800` students enrolled in its afternoon elective blocks. Of these students, `32%` are registered for a computer science course.
What is the total number of students registered for the computer science course?

During its `text(first year)` of operation, a boutique online retail shop fulfilled `300` customer orders. In its `text(second year)`, the shop expanded its marketing campaign, and the number of fulfilled orders was `250%` of the `text(first year's)` total.
How many customer orders did the shop fulfill in its `text(second year)`?

A company launched a health program and initially had `50` employees sign up for gym memberships. By the end of the year, human resources reported that the number of participating employees had dramatically increased to `310%` of the initial signup count.
How many employees were participating in the program at the end of the year?
An artisan bakery tracks its daily output of baked goods. On a standard weekday, the bakery produces 200 loaves of sourdough bread.
Due to lower historical demand, the number of sweet pastry braids baked per day is fixed at 64% of the sourdough production baseline.
To prepare for a weekend morning market, the number of croissants baked is scaled up to 250% of the weekday sourdough production baseline.
What is the total number of sweet pastry braids and croissants baked during this preparation cycle?

What is the new total number of smart watches in the fulfillment center?

A high school chess club has `60` active members at the beginning of the academic year. After several weeks, scheduling conflicts with winter sports cause the active student membership to decrease by `25%`.
What is the new number of active members remaining in the chess club?

What is the new cloud server storage capacity, in `text(gigabytes)`?

A commercial agricultural farm historically required `text(800 hours)` of manual tractor labor per harvest cycle. After upgrading to an automated, GPS-guided fleet tracking system, the farm managers successfully decrease the required manual labor `text(hours)` by `15%`.
How many manual labor `text(hours)` are required under the new automated system?
